stories.title: MLB trade dominoes: Predicting where the 10 biggest names on the market will land
stories.summary: Based on what ESPN's Jeff Passan is hearing, we predict where the top trade candidates will land -- and how they impact each other.

stories.title: Sources: Mets start dealing, ship Minter to Twins
stories.summary: The last-place Mets, in what could be the first of multiple deals, have traded left-handed relief pitcher A.J. Minter to the Twins for prospects Bruin Agbayani and Billy Amick.

stories.title: Deebo back to 49ers on 1-year deal, sources say
stories.summary: Free agent Deebo Samuel is signing back with the 49ers on a 1-year deal that could be worth up to $7 million, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: FIFA plans for 64-team WC despite backlash
stories.summary: FIFA has started a consultation process over an expansion of the Men's World Cup to 64 teams, with documents seen by ESPN aiming for a decision by Aug. 14.

stories.title: Sparks' Plum on trade speculation: 'It's business'
stories.summary: Five-time All-Star guard Kelsey Plum said she's "not taking anything personal" amid growing speculation that the Sparks could move her before Sunday's trade deadline
